messages:
jamie: quick UX thought — people keep opening diffs to see why a suggested approval was blocked. proposing an inline micro-summary line under each diff: short failure reason + a 'Why blocked' caret that expands inline. keeps context without full panel.

noor: nice. keep it single-line by default with ellipses. expand should show 2-3 lines: failing assertions and metric delta. avoid showing model output.

felix: keyboard: when a diff is focused hitting 'b' should toggle the blocked reason. add a small focus-only hint: 'Press B to see why blocked'. ensure focus remains on the diff row when toggling.

jamie: copy idea for collapsed: 'Blocked: 2 failures' and on expand 'Blocked because: 2 failing assertions; -6% accuracy'. keep visible label short to reduce bias.

a11y-bot: accessibility: use a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls for the caret. Provide aria-live polite messages when the reason expands: 'Blocked reason expanded: two failing assertions'. Also put the full human-readable reason in aria-describedby of the approve button.

noor: visual: neutral muted text in small size, 12px, contrast >= 4.5. collapsed state shows dot icon + label; expanded state shows border-left highlight.

felix: bulk behavior: if any selected diffs have blocked reasons, disable bulk approve and show top banner: 'Bulk approve unavailable: selected diffs contain blockers'. include a 'Show blockers' button that filters selection to only blocked items.

analytics: emit events: blocker_shown, blocker_toggled, bulk_approve_blocked, show_blockers_filtered. include run_id and diff_ids.

jamie: action items: 1) mock collapsed vs expanded (noor) 2) keyboard + aria snippet (felix) 3) analytics events spec (analytics). will ship behind flag 'inline-blocker-reasons' and collect usage for 2 weeks.

noor: mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/links/inline-blockers-mock — comments welcome.

felix: I'll prototype keyboard handler and aria markup and add tests for focus behavior and aria-live announcements.

jamie: thanks everyone — this should cut down panel opens by a lot. :thumbsup:
